items.source: Abstract base class for creating Function callbacks around synchronous tool methods. This class extends AbstractAsyncMcpToolMethodCallback and provides synchronous wrapper methods for handling tool requests. It converts the asynchronous reactive methods from the parent class into synchronous equivalents suitable for blocking operations.
items.translation: 用于围绕同步工具方法创建 Function 回调的抽象基类。 该类扩展了 AbstractAsyncMcpToolMethodCallback，并提供用于处理工具请求的同步包装方法。它将父类中的异步响应式方法转换为适用于阻塞操作的同步等效方法。
